'''Ooo-temiuk''' was a [[Forest/Legends|forested]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Ooo-temiuk system/Legends|Ooo-temiuk system]], a part of the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was situated on the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]], which linked it to the [[C-Foroon system/Legends|C-Foroon]] and [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

Ooo-temiuk was [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] around [[75 BBY]] by members of the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] as part of a migration wave from their violence-plagued [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Savareen sector/Legends|Savareen sector]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Tyrius system/Legends|Tyrius system]]</ref> planet [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]],<ref name="TEA" /> and shared its name with [[Ooo-sek]], another Rodian colony<ref name="Creatures">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref> in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA Ooo-sek">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Ooo-sek system/Legends|Ooo-sek system]]</ref> In the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] leading up to<ref name="TEA" /> [[43 ABY]],<ref name="date">The main section of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which includes a description of Ooo-temiuk, ends with a mention of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]]'s journey across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the beginning of which is depicted in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''. The events of that novel are dated to [[43 ABY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> the [[Greel Wood Logging Corporation]] of the Arkanis [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] [[Pii system/Legends|Pii system]] planted stands of [[greel tree]] [[Plant/Legends|saplings]] on Ooo-temiuk.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ooo-temiuk was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-16.<ref name="TEA" />
